name: @tol/events
description: Domain event definitions (the spec names ~24 events, e.g. rfq.sent, quote.selected, deal.activated). Distinct from AuditEvent — domain events are append-only business facts; audit events capture who viewed/changed restricted values. earlier: the RFQ + Deal Room event catalog, the substrate for P14's 'timeline' surface. Zero runtime dependencies, same discipline as @tol/authz/@tol/domain — persistence-agnostic; @tol/db's DomainEvent table + domainEventRepository (packages/db) is where these actually get written, apps/api's services do the mapping.
